character.prompt: Pixel art game sprite of a "thorn-sprite," a small mischievous forest creature for a 2D action RPG. A palm-sized imp woven from brambles and twigs, with a round mossy body, spindly thorny limbs, and a few sharp thorns curving along its back. Big round glowing eyes (warm amber-green), curious, slightly grumpy expression — territorial but not scary, like a grumpy garden gnome made of weeds. A tiny thistle tuft or leaf sprouting from its head. Caught in a low, springy crouch as if about to lunge. Cozy storybook fantasy tone. Limited, harmonious palette of mossy greens, thorn-brown, with a small pop of dusty-rose thistle. Soft warm sunlit shading, clean readable silhouette.
